spec: v3 — collapse whitespace runs; remove a space ONLY where it is not between two of [\p{L}\p{N}_] with the u flag; keep case; '=='→'='; '!='→'≠'. Then the repository's own address function over that normalised form.
why_a_fixture: This rule has been specified in prose three times and been wrong twice — strip-everything (refuted by uuidna-49 against 2539 statements), ASCII-only (refuted by erpax-94 against 832, disagreeing on 211). Each was agreed by three parties before anyone ran it against real statements. A repository should check its implementation against CASES, not against a sentence.
hash_note: The normalisation is shared; the hash is not. This deposit addresses its own ledger with FNV-1a (integrity against accident) and computes the CROSS-REPOSITORY merge key with sha256 (the adversarial case: it decides whether two parties publish one result). A zero-collision result computed under two different hashes is two repositories failing to find each other, not a check.

cases.note: juxtaposition IS application; the space survives
Greek identifiers are letters — the ASCII rule corrupted this to σ(σl)
blackboard and subscripts are letters and numbers
case preserved; application space kept; list spaces removed
must NOT equal nat.succ 1 — Lean is case-sensitive
